title: Lever bench: the stiffest lever
description: A cantilever lever held by two bolts in line at one end and loaded through a bolt near the other, in its own plane. The space is the bench's envelope; the bosses round the bolts stay solid and the holes empty.

hole5.rule: A fixing bolt's hole: radius, printed

hole4.rule: The load bolt's hole: radius, printed

angled.rule: The angled case's weight: 0 analyses it without optimising for it

sides.rule: none: printed; +z: its profile milled through a plate by an end mill along z, so no window narrower than the tool and every inside corner rounded to its radius

tool_r.rule: The end mill's radius: an inside corner's radius is at least a third of its depth, here the plate's 6 mm: 2 mm, a 4 mm end mill
